$comment: PRESENTATION. Nothing here says what happens — only how it looks and how fast. Edit this file and every screenplay you own re-renders with the new look. This is the document you iterate on over time.

timing.$comment: Durations are DERIVED, not hardcoded, so the same screenplay works with typed captions or spoken voiceover. readingSpeed is ms per character; a future 'voice' mode replaces this with real audio length and every beat re-times itself.

caption.$comment: Flat scalar fields — one axis at a time, no CSS shorthand to re-parse (shape borrowed from Cap). `preset` picks a whole look; fields here override it. `variants` are partial, semantic looks a `say` beat opts into with `as`. The screenplay names the intent (`as:"warn"`); this file owns the colours.

click.$comment: The click highlight — its own knob, per your note.

encode.$comment: One recording pass, many outputs. Add entries to render more.
